name: 🔧 Mechanic Legends [BETA]
desc:
🔧 Welcome to the ultimate Mechanic car experience

Take on customer jobs, repair and modify your cars. Push the limits till they need repairing!
Find & Collect some of the rarest cars

🗺️ Cruise the vast map of Los Archilis with your friends!

What will you build?

llm.loop: take customer repair jobs -> earn cash -> buy/collect rare cars and parts -> modify and drive them around the open map
llm.objectives: complete mechanic jobs, collect rare cars, build and tune your own cars
llm.progression: cash, garage/car collection, car upgrades and mods
llm.instructions: take customer jobs, repair and modify cars, find rare cars, cruise the Los Archilis map with friends
unique: mechanic repair-shop job loop combined with open-world driving and rare car collecting
llm.thumbnails: rendered yellow sports car with exposed flaming engine doing a burnout, car at a fuel pump with mechanic character, blue car on a wooden lift; game logo
llm.complexity_notes: vast open map, drivable car chassis with part-level repair/tuning systems, multiple car models
